Role Position Mapping establishes a bijection between players and their functional roles, enabling combinatorial analysis of team configurations. Team Composition Vector treats each lineup as a vector in a high-dimensional space, allowing probabilistic modeling of team effectiveness under permutation. Institutional Hierarchy Graph captures authority relationships as directed edges, forming a lattice structure useful for analyzing command flows and decision propagation. Dualities emerge in how these structures interlock—roles map to vectors, which map to graphs. Failure modes include non-injective mappings (duplicate roles), inconsistent ordering (hierarchical violations), and incomplete coverage (missing players).
